heard: Think the moon doesn't spin, that is a total myth. Our moon actually rotates on its axis at the exact same speed it orbits Earth, a perfect celestial match. This synchronous tidal locking is caused by Earth's gravity, stretching the lunar body into subtle, physical bulges. As the moon spins, these bulges get carried slightly out of alignment, generating a powerful gravitational braking torque. This constant friction slows its rotation and pushes the Moon away from us by 4 centimeters every year. Because of this locking, humanity did not see the far side until the Soviet Pro-Bluna 3 photographed it in 1959. Tidal locking hides the far side, which is why people still believe the Moon never rotates.
differences: 'probe luna' heard as 'pro bluna' after 'until the soviet'
